replacement_reason: Remove semantic restatements of old inputs or number-only task variants; preserve category counts.
retained_flags_reason: Remaining lexical flags predominantly share instruction boilerplate, not task identity. Related mathematical concepts remain, but supplied information and requested reasoning differ; no number-only Q-to-H copying.
examples: List append/extend versus queue/stack shares Explain the difference phrasing, but asks a distinct API effect.
Dictionary value addition versus sorted-list merge has different operands, state and outputs.
Runner multi-leg mean speed versus constant-speed unit conversion is a different calculation protocol.
Rectangle area-to-dimensions versus perimeter-to-width uses different constraints; geometry topic overlap is disclosed.
Silhouette, timer context manager, ballast, hardness/toughness, linked-list cycle, grouped SQL orders and repeating decimal restatements were removed.
limitations: Lexical deduplication and manual task review do not prove semantic independence or IID sampling.
Corpora are authored broad-workload blocks; statistical statements remain conditional on the registered exchangeability assumption.
Code tasks intentionally include different language families across Q and H; H is not tuned after outputs.
Historical exact token-ID audit remains mandatory after pinned tokenization.
